96 
 
 
 
 
 
 Plus, Salesforce adds Braze to its cloud | Tuesday, October 20, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 View in browser 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 PRESENTED BY WESTERN ALLIANCE’S INNOVATION BANKING GROUP, MEMBER FDIC 
 
 
   
 
 
 Axios Pro Rata 
 
 
 
 
 By Dan Primack · Oct 20, 2026 
 
 
 🎟️ Axios Media Trends Live is today. Watch live beinning at 3pm ET.

 Guests include: Saturday Night Live's Kenan Thompson , WSJ editor-in-chief Emma Tucker , Dow Jones CEO Almar Latour , Trump Media & Technology Group CEO Kevin McGurn , iHeartMedia CEO Bob Pittman , and FCC commissioner Anna Gomez . 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Share today’s Axios Pro Rata 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Top of the Morning 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Illustration: Aïda Amer/Axios

 
 
 
   
 
 The Federal Trade Commission and a dozen state attorneys general have sued to stop Platinum Equity and portfolio company PlayPower from buying rival playground equipment maker BCI Burke from Bertram Capital.

 Why it matters: It's been rare in Trump 2.0 for federal and state antitrust regulators to work in concert.

 Zoom in: At a top level, this feels like basic antitrust enforcement. The FTC and states argue that the merger would increase prices — particularly for schools, municipalities, churches that buy outdoor playground equipment — and decrease product innovation.

 But the case also may test Biden-era merger guidelines that take particular aim at serial acquirers. Specifically, they say that if a deal is part of a pattern or strategy of multiple acquisitions, the regulators can "consider the cumulative effect." PlayPower has made several large acquisitions over the past few decades, including Playworld in 2016, although all of that predates Platinum's ownership. So it both is and isn't about private equity rollups. Also: Another part of the Biden-era guidelines was that regulators could consider a merger's concentration impact on an already-consolidated market.

 In this situation, the FTC argues that the top five players — including PlayPower and BCI Burke — have combined market share of between 85% and 90%. Primary sources: Read the FTC's complaint .

 What they're saying: Colorado AG Phil Weiser said in a statement: "PlayPower competes head-to-head with Burke today, but PlayPower is losing ground to Burke. Rather than strengthen its competitive efforts against its rival, PlayPower is attempting to eliminate the pressure it faces from Burke by acquiring it."

 A PlayPower spokesperson said: "We continue to believe that our merger with BCI Burke would create even more competition in a highly fragmented and globally competitive market, not diminish it. By bringing together two complementary businesses, we would create a stronger American company [for] all stakeholders ... We remain confident in the merits of our combination and look forward to working with the Commission to reach a resolution." An FTC spokesperson pointed Axios to a joint federal/state antitrust case brought in early 2025 against GTCR's purchase of Surmodics, and adds that "we always welcome state partners in our litigation" — including on consumer protection issues. The bottom line: If this actually goes to court, it could have reverberations for future rollups.

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 The BFD 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Illustration: Allie Carl/Axios

 
 
 
   
 
 Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) has agreed to acquire marketing platform Braze (Nasdaq: BRZE) for $5.66 billion in cash.

 Why it's the BFD: We're a long way since 2023, when Salesforce dissolved its board M&A committee, in part because of how hard it was to integrate a trio of mega-deals (MuleSoft, Tableau, and Slack).

 It's also an admission that Salesforce's marketing cloud could use some seeding. By the numbers: Braze stockholders will receive $47.50 per share, a 58% premium to yesterday's closing price. Braze went public in 2021 at $65 per share.

 This would be Salesforce's fifth-largest acquisition. The bottom line: Why build when you can buy?

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Venture Capital Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • Neolix , a Chinese robo-van maker, raised $400m in Series E funding. Boyu Capital l ed, joined by Alibaba, Monolith Management, Granite Asia Capital, Vertex and insiders Stone Venture and Trustar Capital. axios.link/4yZ5hfB 

 • Otter , a meeting note-taking app, raised $320m from General Catalyst 's Customer Value Fund. axios.link/4Bei4w2 

 • Arda , a manufacturing AI startup led by ex-OpenAI exec Bob McGrew, raised $232m in Series A funding at a $1.5b valuation. Altimeter Capital , Accel and Khosla Ventures led, joined by Felicis, XYZ Venture Capital, and 8VC. axios.link/4yAAmW2 

 • DoubleAI , an Israeli startup focused on AI cost containment, raised $220m from Lightspeed, Bessemer Venture Partners, Nvidia, and Dell. axios.link/4yY758u 

 • Eka Robotics , a developer of general-purpose robots, raised $150m in Series A funding at a $1.45b valuation. A16z and F-Prime led, joined by insiders Obvious Ventures and E14 Fund. axios.link/3TRR8BI 

 • Blackwall , an Estonian web traffic management platform, raised $100m in Series C funding at a $2.2b valuation. AVP led, joined by insiders Dawn Capital, MMC Ventures, and Tera Ventures. axios.link/47uRj9e 

 • Dream Labs , an SF-based developer of foundation models for robotics, raised $90m in seed funding. B Capital and Kindred Ventures led, joined by A.Capital, Unusual Ventures, SV Angel, Wing VC, Scribble VC, and Adrian Aoun. bit.ly/4k2WCnB 

 • Oro Mobility , a fleet platform owned by Hertz , raised $80m from Cohen Private Ventures, Certares Opportunities, and Knighthead Capital Management. axios.link/4zFU4QO 

 🚑 Baba , a patient advocacy startup for Medicare and Medicare Advantage, raised $40m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro . FirstMark led, joined by CVS Health Ventures, Valtrius, and current backers General Catalyst, Genius Ventures, and Ground Up Ventures. axios.link/4zIrvCC 

 🚑 ZAP Surgical Systems , a San Carlos, Calif.-based robotic radiosurgery platform, raised $36m. Catalio Capital Management led, joined by Baheal. axios.link/4zETQJP 

 • High Lander , an Israeli provider of autonomous aviation software, raised $30m from EDGE Group, STEP, Protego, and Kinetica. axios.link/4yXMP6T 

 🚑 Phantom Neuro , an Austin, Texas-based developer of sensors to control prosthetic limbs, is seeking roughly $30m in Series B funding, per Axios Pro. Insiders include Ottobock, Breakout Ventures, Draper Associates, and LionBird Ventures. axios.link/4BhcOaY 

 • Tolan , an AI companion, raised $30m from USV, Khosla Ventures, and Homebrew. axios.link/3U1APSU 

 • Firefly , an NYC-based physical AI safety startup, raised $20m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro . Definition Capital led, joined by BoxGroup and Susa Ventures. axios.link/4yPAlxD 

 🌏 IMIO , a Chicago-based maker of agricultural biologicals, raised $12m, per Axios Pro . Sofinnova Partners led, joined by Cultivate Next, Starshot Capital, Grow Together Salinas, Earth Foundry, and Serra Ventures. axios.link/4z3z7zy 

 🚑 Sunlight AI , an admin startup for independent medical practices, raised $10m in seed funding, per Axios Pro . Basis Set Ventures led, joined by Sofeon Ventures, Social Leverage, Actions Capital, Overlook Ventures, Early Light Ventures, and Renegade Capital. axios.link/4ejFXZk 

 🚑 XRlabs , a London-based surgical intelligence platform, raised $8.4m in seed funding, per Axios Pro . Playground Global led, joined by Eka Ventures. axios.link/4yzwPqF 

 • Rosie , a Seattle-based platform for on-demand childcare and household services, raised $7m over two rounds from Bling Capital, Reach Capital, Graham & Walker, Marketplace Capital, Ingeborg Investments, Precursor Ventures, Mother Ventures, and Yonder Ventures. axios.link/4dODeqD 

 • Jooba , an SF-based recruiting platform, raised $4m from a16z, Scribble Ventures, and Genius Ventures. axios.link/3WBh6dn 

 🚑 Nabta Health , a UAE-based provider of preventive women's health services, raised $3m led by Phoenix Venture Partners . axios.link/481dB2r 

 🚀 Reflex Aerospace , a German maker of satellite platforms, raised funding from Nvidia . axios.link/4i67ejb 

 
 
   
 
   
A MESSAGE FROM WESTERN ALLIANCE’S INNOVATION BANKING GROUP, MEMBER FDIC

 
 Helping build the blueprint for the future 
   
 
 
 
   
 
 Industry expertise matters when companies are building something new. The right banking relationship starts with understanding where that vision is headed. Hear how Hadrian's CFO found a bank whose industry experience helped grow the company's vision and long-term goals.


 Read and watch. 


 
   
 
   
 
 
 Private Equity Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • American Industrial Partners and Silgan (NYSE: SLN) agreed to buy Dutch consumer goods packaging maker Trivium Packaging for $3.4b (including debt) from ​ Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan and Ardagh Group . axios.link/4iclDuc 

 🚑 Archimed acquired a majority stake in London-based medical imaging cloud 3verest . axios.link/4yuuYn0 

 • Arlington Capital Partners acquired Gooch & Housego , a maker of photonic and optical components and subsystems. axios.link/4hWbwea 

 • Banner Capital acquired Exterior Solutions Group , an Edmond, Okla.-based commercial roofer. axios.link/4eIxmj0 

 • Boomi , a business software firm owned by Francisco Partners and TPG , acquired Elementary Data , an Israeli data observability tool, for over $40m in cash and stock. axios.link/3Ub7dCy 

 🚑 Forward Consumer Partners agreed to buy bandage brand Welly from Unilever (NYSE: UL). axios.link/4jwQdAX 

 • Kian Capital acquired Allen Supply , a Saginaw, Mich.-based distributor of commercial doors and hardware accessories. axios.link/4sn3AGo 

 🚑 Life Science Connect , a Latticework Capital Management portfolio company, acquired BrevisRefero , a Toronto-based biopharma consultancy. axios.link/4jx8WMS 

 • Lightview Capital invested in Thorn Run Partners , a Washington D.C.-based lobbying firm. axios.link/4dMmWhY 

 • NexTech Solutions , backed by Clairvest Group , acquired Halcyon Days Consulting , a Stevensville, Md.-based provider of tactical mission networks and operational software for the U.S. military and allies. axios.link/4k5Zgcc 

 • Platinum Equity agreed to acquire a majority stake in Trime , an Italian maker of mobile lighting towers, generators, and security towers. axios.link/4dPpSuf 

 • Solen Software Group acquired Cooperative Technologies , an Atlanta-based provider of annuity and life insurance replacement data software. axios.link/4z3npoA 

 🚑 Tegria , backed by Altaris , acquired CloudWave , a Marlborough, Mass.-based cybersecurity provider for health care. axios.link/4yrq0HX 

 • Tikehau Capital , a French alt investment firm, is seeking a strategic investor, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4sdPuXN 

 • Wateralia , an Ambienta portfolio company, acquired CSA , an Italian maker of valves for water networks. axios.link/4dOfq6g 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Liquidity Events 
 
 
   
 
 • Kapital , a Mexican commercial bank, agreed to acquire Woz , an SF-based AI app builder, for $30m in cash and stock. Woz seed backers include Cervin Ventures, Burst Capital, YC, Untapped Ventures, MGV, and the Lacob Family. axios.link/4hT7ByF 

 • Maximus (NYSE: MMS) agreed to acquire Agile Defense , a McLean, Va.-based provider of digital services for government, from Enlightenment Capital for $660m in cash. axios.link/3VZXmzY 

 🚑 Parkview Health , a rural health system in Indiana, agreed to acquire Brentwood, Tenn.-based RCM vendor Ovation Healthcare from Grant Avenue . Axios Pro flashback 

 • Tradeweb (Nasdaq: TW) agreed to acquire Trumid , an NYC-based credit trading marketplace, for $1.97b (including $220m of tax assets). Trumid has raised over $700m, including at a $2.4b post-money valuation in 2021, from firms like Point Break Capital Management, Dragoneer, DST Global, Motive Partners, Senator Investment Group, TPG, BlackRock and T. Rowe Price. axios.link/3VQgjFm 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 More M&A 
 
 
   
 
 ⚡ Gulf Keystone Petroleum (LSE: GKP) agreed to merge with ShaMaran Petroleum (Oslo: SNMS) in a $601m all-stock deal. axios.link/4enyc4B 

 • H.B. Fuller (NYSE: FUL) rejected Ancora 's sweetened $1.4b bid for its building adhesives business. axios.link/4z8ylRR 

 • IXL Learning acquired NoRedInk , a Covina, Calif.-based platform for English language arts education. axios.link/3WBk6GH 

 🚑 Roche (Swiss: ROP) agreed to an ADC-focused biobucks deal with China's Hansoh Pharmaceutica l (HK: 3692) that could be worth up to $15b, including $400m in upfront cash. axios.link/4yUrJq3 

 • Prudential Financial (NYSE: PRU) agreed to sell its Brazil and Mexico units to French ​insurer CNP ​Assurances Group for $4.03b in cash. axios.link/4yUmAOJ 

 • TTM Technologies (Nasdaq: TTMI) agreed to acquire Ophir Optics , a maker of infrared thermal imaging and laser optics solutions, from MKS (Nasdaq: MKSI) for $650m in cash. axios.link/4i3polp 

 • William Blair acquired Armentum Partners , an SF-based debt and alternative capital advisory firm. axios.link/4yxetXz 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Fundraising 
 
 
   
 
 ⚡️ Ara Partners raised about $2.5b for its first energy projects fund. axios.link/4yYPCgp 

 🦬 Bison Ventures raised $120m for its second fund. axios.link/4hX4XYN 

 ⚡️ Blackstone raised $8.7b for its fifth energy transition fund. axios.link/4hUn5Cu 

 • The City of Milwaukee Employees' Retirement System plans to pause new private equity commitments in 2027. Private equity currently accounts for over 12% of its $6.7b in assets. bit.ly/4zBje38 

 ⚽ Clara Vista Investment Partners is raising $250m to invest in soccer clubs, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4zyInve 

 • Inspired Capital , an early-stage VC firm founded by Alexa von Tobel and Penny Pritzker, raised $450m for its fourth fund. axios.link/4ivDHkb 

 • Monomoy Capital Partners raised $589m for a small-cap fund. axios.link/3U1pL8h 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 It's Personnel 
 
 
   
 
 • Sarah Bond , former Xbox president, joined LionTree as a senior advisor. axios.link/4zzDcLM 

 🚑 Bruce Robertson joined THL Partners as a managing director focused on health care. He previously was with H.I.G. Capital. axios.link/4hW0iGp 

 • John Vaske joined Evercore as a senior managing director of chemicals investment banking. He previously was with Ducera Partners. axios.link/47u2nn2 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Final Numbers 
 
 
   
 
 Data: Financial Modeling Prep ; Chart: Dan Primack/Axios Earnings season kicks off on Thursday for alternative investment firms, when Blackstone reports before the bell. Ares and Blue Owl come next week, with firms like Apollo and KKR to report in early November.

 Expect a lot of focus on AI-related private credit investments. Thus far, it's been a miserable year for all of their stock prices.

 A new chapter for American manufacturing 
   
 
 
 
   
 
 Hadrian is focused on helping reindustrialize America by expanding manufacturing capacity, creating jobs and using automation to help workers reach new levels of productivity.


 Read how the company's CFO describes that mission and the role Western Alliance Bank has played along the way.
